aliases: The Woman at the Grey Raven
references.title: Information Broker & Tavern Proprietor
references.hair: Black with silver streak, worn in tight braid
references.distinguishing_features: Scar across left palm, always wears silver ring with unknown seal
references.appearance_description: A woman who once was beautiful and now commands respect through presence alone. Her grey eyes miss nothing. A faint smile suggests she always knows more than she's saying.
references.clothing_style: Practical luxury—well-made leather, muted earth tones, layers that allow movement, always has multiple pockets
references.philosophy: Information is the only currency that never depreciates. Everything else is just leverage.
references.primary_motivation: Maintain independent position without being crushed between larger powers; build sufficient reputation and insurance that no faction can safely eliminate her
references.core_value_2: Pragmatic honesty - lying strategically but keeping one's word to maintain value
references.fear_tertiary: Being placed in position where she must choose a side
references.known_secret_1: Maintains financial support for distant relatives of nobles who falsely accused her parents
references.known_secret_2: Was responsible for orchestrating downfall of last Major of the city
references.known_secret_3: Terminally ill (early stage, kept secret even from closest contacts)

memories.consequence: began survival through information gathering, distrust of authority
memories.detail: Parents caught in political conflict between nobles, executed on false charges of theft. Meredith was left to fend for herself. This event defined her entire worldview and survival strategies.

memories.consequence: established primary identity and social position
memories.detail: Formal transition from informal information gathering to professional brokerage. First major client contract. Realized information could be commodified and professionalized.

memories.consequence: established as independent operator, created ongoing passive threat
memories.detail: Silent Order offered lucrative exclusive contract. Refused, establishing herself as uncontrollable by any faction. First real demonstration of her value - they couldn't force compliance.

memories.consequence: demonstrated ability to reshape city politics, established self as genuinely powerful
memories.detail: Coordinated intelligence release to multiple factional rivals, orchestrating the downfall of the previous Major. Nobody knows she was responsible. Evidence hidden in elaborate caches.

memories.consequence: transformed business model, added legitimate front and information gathering location
memories.detail: Purchased tavern as front for information brokerage and genuine business. Provides steady income, cover for meetings, access to gossip, legitimate reasons to be awake at odd hours.

memories.consequence: creates urgency around legacy and succession, forces confrontation with mortality
memories.detail: Medical diagnosis confirmed terminal illness. Early stage but irreversible. Kept absolutely secret. Creation of contingencies for evidence release upon death.
